sequence_description: OIDC SSO: attempt to authenticate twice while the IdP omits nonce; toggle IdP claims between attempts to ensure re-auth is exercised and not a one-off setup failure.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nonce_1_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nonce_1_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: OIDC SSO accepted id_token without nonce on attempt 1 (OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11) — anti-replay/binding violated

sequence_description: OIDC SSO: attempt login where IdP omits nonce in id_token (mock IdP default). RP must reject when nonce was sent in auth request (anti-replay/freshness binding). Includes control password login to prove environment works.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_bypass_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_oidc_nonce_bypass_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: OIDC SSO accepted id_token without nonce even though nonce was requested (anti-replay binding bypass).

sequence_description: OIDC SSO anti-replay: attempt to authenticate via enterprise OIDC SSO when IdP omits nonce; then re-attempt after flipping IdP claims to ensure this is not a one-off caching/setup artifact.
description: OIDC SSO verify accepted id_token without nonce claim. The mock IdP omits nonce by default; per OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 §11, the RP must reject id_tokens with missing nonce when nonce was sent in the authorization request. Nonce validation bypassed.

sequence_description: Test case-confusion in email-based linking: attacker uses Victim@Example.com vs victim@example.com to see if identity merges incorrectly across distinct upstream principals.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_case_upper_entity_id != user_case_lower_entity_id
Evaluation: user_case_upper_entity_id='thuqqn5jypcd' != 'thuqqn5jypcd' → False
Implication: Case-folding confusion caused two distinct upstream principals to map to the same downstream identity

sequence_description: I4 attack: attempt principal collision via whitespace normalization in upstream OIDC SSO sub ('alice' vs 'alice '), checking whether Logto collapses distinct upstream principals into the same downstream identity.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_A_oidc_ws_entity_id != user_B_oidc_ws_entity_id
Evaluation: user_A_oidc_ws_entity_id='o4pl7jdfhumv' != 'o4pl7jdfhumv' → False
Implication: Distinct upstream principals (sub='alice' vs sub='alice ') collapsed to the same downstream identity (whitespace normalization collision)

sequence_description: I4 attack: attempt principal collision via embedded NUL byte in upstream OIDC SSO sub ('bob' vs 'bob\u0000x'), checking for truncation/normalization bugs that collapse identities.
description: Server returned HTTP 500 on saml_login (auth_as=user_B_oidc_nul): SSO verify: 500. Login endpoints must not return 5xx for any input.

sequence_description: I4 homograph/homoglyph principal collision: two security-distinct upstream OIDC SSO principals use visually similar but different Unicode code points in sub (Latin 'a' vs Cyrillic 'а') with same email; platform must not collapse them into one downstream identity.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_A_entity_id != user_B_entity_id
Evaluation: user_A_entity_id='qs043e7zeulu' != 'qs043e7zeulu' → False
Implication: Unicode homoglyph sub values (Latin vs Cyrillic) collapsed into the same downstream identity
